AgentActionKind.title: AgentActionKind
AgentActionKind.description:
The meaningful actions a tool may prepare. Each maps to one authorized service call
performed only on explicit UI confirmation (never by the agent).

ConfirmActionInput.title: ConfirmActionInput
ConfirmActionInput.description:
What the product UI submits when the user confirms a :class:`PreparedAction`. The
token and version are echoed from the prepared action; the service re-derives the token
from the resource's current state and refuses the call if it no longer matches.

Money.title: Money
Money.description:
Integer minor units of an explicit ISO 4217 currency. No float, no implicit
conversion, no arithmetic across currencies.

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Illustrative scenario — generated assumptions, not measured local data. No web research or verified city records were used. Baseline inputs are unchanged. Groundwater levels, daily history, reliable yield and shortage days remain unknown.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: What readiness covers. 'configuration' means only that settings passed fail-closed validation at startup; no dependency (emulator, Firestore, storage) connectivity is checked yet.
